discussion.key_messages: - There is a Moderate Risk for Excessive Rainfall (level 3 of 4) across portions of southern Utah, as a surge of moisture brings widespread rainfall across the region. A Flood Watch is in effect for much of southern and east central Utah through this evening. - Accumulating mountain snow is expected across all Utah mountains through Monday morning. Upwards of 12" of snow is expected above 9000 feet, and 3-6" of snow down to around 7000 feet. Upper elevations of the Cottonwoods and western Uintas may see localized accumulations 18-24". - Cool, dry, and stable conditions will temporarily build in by Tuesday before the passage of a weak storm system Wednesday into Thursday.
